title: Why The Panama Canal Had To Ration Its Ships
hook: The Panama Canal is down to 24 ships a day because of a drought.
closing: Water: the one thing a canal can't fake its way around.
question: Ever had a shipment stuck? Tell me.

segments.say: A historic drought forced the Panama Canal to cut its normal daily ship crossings down to just 24.
The lake that feeds the canal's locks dropped to just 80.3 feet -- well below its normal average.
That forced ships to carry less cargo too -- the maximum draft dropped to just 44 feet.
